title: Sentences
summary: Sentences built from their words, written down as they are said, then their gaps filled.
description: Words in use: whole sentences, recalled by building them and by ear.

requirements.text: A new sentence is shown on a card and then built from its words.
A sentence met before is either built from its words or written down as it is said, taking turns as it comes back.
Where speaking cards are on, at most two known sentences in a lesson are said aloud instead.
A sentences lesson ends with fill-the-gaps cards over its own sentences.
A course's new sentences are cut into sentences lessons of five.
